q1.sampleAnswer: Items generally given to a charity shop include clothes, books, cameras and more.
q1.explanationZh: 第二段第一句列出了捐赠物：衣服、书、相机等。

evidence.quote: The donations we get include clothes, books, cameras and more.

q2.sampleAnswer: The author put each piece of clothing on a hanger and checked the size tag on it.

keyPoints.descZh: 把衣服挂到衣架上并检查尺码标签
examples: put each piece of clothing on a hanger and checked the size tag on it

q2.rubricZh: 要点：挂上衣架；检查尺码标签。
q2.explanationZh: 第二段说作者把每件衣服放到衣架上，还检查了尺码标签。

evidence.quote: I put each piece of clothing on a hanger and checked the size tag on it.

q3.sampleAnswer: They usually base their design on one main item or piece of clothing.

keyPoints.descZh: 以一件主要的物品或衣服为基础来设计
examples: base their design on one main item or piece of clothing

q3.rubricZh: 要点：以一件主要物品或衣物为基础设计。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段说橱窗陈列通常以一件主要的物品或衣服为基础来设计。

evidence.quote: We usually base our design on one main item or piece of clothing.

q4.sampleAnswer: The author greeted customers and introduced the goods to them.

keyPoints.descZh: 迎接顾客并向他们介绍商品
examples: greeted customers and introduced the goods to them

q4.rubricZh: 要点：迎接顾客；介绍商品。
q4.explanationZh: 第四段说开店后，作者迎接顾客，并向他们介绍商品。

evidence.quote: I greeted our customers and introduced the goods to them.

q5.sampleAnswer: Because by learning more about the items, the author could tell the guests more information if they asked.

keyPoints.descZh: 这样顾客询问时能提供更多信息
examples: could tell the guests more information if they asked

q5.rubricZh: 要点：顾客询问时能告诉他们更多信息。
q5.explanationZh: 第四段说了解物品后，顾客问起来就能告诉他们更多信息。

evidence.quote: In this way, I could tell our guests more information if they asked

q6.sampleAnswer: I think it is a great experience to volunteer in a charity shop, because it allows us to learn new skills and give back to society. (Any reasonable answers are acceptable.)

keyPoints.descZh: 给出合理的观点并说明理由
examples: It is a great experience because we can learn new skills and give back to society.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题：观点明确、理由合理即可。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题。表达你的看法并说出理由，比如能学到新技能、回报社会，就可以。

evidence.quote: It has taught me new skills and allowed me to gain more experience.

q7.explanationZh: begin 变成 beginning，was beginning to 是“开始……”，船正开始快速下沉。

q8.explanationZh: base 的形容词是 basic（基本的），basic unit 是基本单位。

q9.explanationZh: be designed to 是“被设计用来……”，用过去分词 designed。

q10.explanationZh: society 的形容词是 social，social club 是社交俱乐部。

q11.explanationZh: perfect 后面要名词，introduce 的名词是 introduction（介绍，入门）。

q12.explanationZh: must be 后用被动语态，teach 的过去分词是 taught。

q13.explanationZh: 前半句是肯定句，反意疑问句后半用否定：don’t I?。主语是 I。

q14.explanationZh: “做完准备工作后才开门”可改成“直到准备工作做完才开门”：didn’t open ... until ...。

q15.explanationZh: 画线部分是做的事情，用 What 提问；原句是过去时，助动词用 did。

q16.explanationZh: why not do sth. 可以改成 how about doing sth. 或 what about doing sth.，意思都是“……怎么样”。

q17.explanationZh: 用 It is important to ... 句型，to check 后面接 whether 引导的宾语从句：It is important to check whether the items are in good condition.
